In Section 3, through the direct Taylor expansion; first deduce the conditions that ensure the present MRT-LB model to be fourth-order consistent with the diagonal-anisotropic diffusion equation; and then present the fourth-order initialization scheme for the MRT-LB model. Thereafter, the condition which guarantees that the MRT-LB model can satisfy the stability structure is provided, and the relationship between the stability structure preserving condition and the L? stability of the MRT-LB model is also discussed.
